images.filename: Garyville and Reserve, Louisiana, and the Marathon Petroleum oil refinery.tif
images.caption:
Joined satellite imagery of Garyville and Reserve, Lousiana. The Marathon Petroleum oil refinery visible in the middle. This is part of a stretch of the Mississippi River between New Orleans and Baton Rouge that is known as "Cancer Alley" because its residence face a cancer risk seven times the national average. More than 200 polluting petrochemical plants, including the refinery in Garyville, have been built along the river here. The satellite imagery comes from the 2022 NOAA National Geodetic Survey DSS 4-Band 8 Bit Imagery: New Orleans, LA dataset. Multiple photos have been stitched together and the image has been rotated to remove black spaces.

images.filename: The Big House - Whitney Plantation Historic District - 2016.jpg
images.caption: The Big House, seen in the movie "Django Unchained."  Raised French Creole style cottage was built of masonry and cypress in the late 18th century. It is one of the earliest and best preserved Creole plantation houses standing on River Road. Sometime prior to 1815, the Big House was expanded to its present configuration with seven rooms on each level, plus a full-length gallery across the front and an open loggia facing the rear. This is also one of the very few historic American houses known to have received decorative wall paintings on both its exterior and interior.
